provenance.notes: ExpressConnect Shipping Integration Guide v3.15: up to 50 consignments a call, 3 creates a call recommended; the documents are TNT proprietary, a third-party developer keeps no TNT information afterwards. Being retired with the TNT brand (FedEx): express.tnt.com/expressconnect/ answered 404 on 2026-11-10 and integrators stopped TNT bookings; FedEx REST (omnibus/fedex) replaces it. CONREF must be unique; a consignment number sent again is refused as a duplicate. Nothing resent by the package.
